name: Species, Subspecies, and Upbringing Inheritance
description: Species and Subspecies encode inherited traits. Upbringings encode acquired traditions, skills and language. Their inheritance graphs are independent and Upbringing associations do not restrict character selection.

speciesInheritance.selection: Selecting a terminal Subspecies resolves its ancestor chain without requiring the user to select each ancestor.
speciesInheritance.filesystem: Directories may mirror the hierarchy but stable parent IDs are authoritative.

upbringings.defaultAssociation: A familiar 5e/5.5e option may resolve to a selected default Upbringing for compatibility, without forbidding alternative selections.

reviewNotes: The Dragonborn trait definitions remain under reconciliation; no placeholder playable Dragonborn records are created here.
